test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following states ranked 1st amongst "Achievers" states in the Logistics Ease Across Different States (LEADS) Report 2022?
solution:
Correct Answer **Maharashtra**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Commerce and Industry **has published the **Logistics Ease Across Different States (LEADS) Report for 2022.**
 
• **LEADS** is a domestically developed index that employs data-driven analysis to evaluate logistics infrastructure, services, and human resources across all **36 States and Union Territories (UTs) of India**.
 
• Serving as a **valuable tool, LEADS** assists in identifying measures to improve** logistics efficiency at the state** and **UT level.**
 
• Furthermore, the report has received international recognition, as it positively correlates with indices such as the **Logistics Performance Index.**
 
• Initially launched in **2018**, the **LEADS report** has been published annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The LEADS Report 2022 categorizes states and union territories into three performance categories based on their percentage scores:

**Achievers: **

 
• This category includes states/UTs that have achieved a **percentage score of 90% or higher.**
 
• The following states/UTs fall under the Achievers category: **Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Chandigarh, Delhi, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Odisha, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Gujarat.**
 
• Among these, **Maharashtra **holds the top position among the** Achievers states.**

**Fast Movers:**

 
• This category comprises states/UTs that have achieved percentage scores ranging from **80% to 90%.**
 
• The **Fast Movers** category includes **Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Puducherry, Sikkim, and Tripura.**

**Aspirers:**

 
• **States/UTs** that have achieved percentage** scores below 80%** are classified under the **Aspirers category.**
 
• However,** specific states **falling under this category have not been mentioned in the provided information.

These performance categories provide a comprehensive assessment of the logistics infrastructure and services across different states and UTs, highlighting the achievements and areas for improvement in the logistics sector.
